vulnerability.explanation: The allocation size is computed as sizeof(codec_t) + sizeof(TIFFCodec) + strlen(name) + 1 and then cast to tmsize_t. For very large name lengths, this sum can overflow the size type, resulting in an undersized allocation. Subsequent writes to cd->info fields and the strcpy(codec_name, name) copy will then write past the end of the allocated block, causing heap memory corruption.
